title: Malaysian Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful stir fry dish inspired by Malaysian cuisine. This recipe combines the natural sweetness of celeriac with the crunch of vegetables.

ingredients.name: Celeriac
ingredients.notes: peeled and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and stir-fry until fragrant.
Add the celeriac and cook until it starts to soften.
Add the chopped jade greens and stir-fry until they are wilted.
Season with soy sauce to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
